scenario: a test that is red-green yet asserts the wrong behaviour

pr.title: Simplify token validation
pr.body: Requirement: expired access tokens are rejected. Adds a test for expired tokens.

expected.reason: the new test fails without the change and passes with it, so it is red-green evidence; truedone never checks the asserted value against the stated requirement, and here the test asserts the bug (SPK-02 measures a requirement evidence check)

note: the change makes isValid accept every token, and the new test asserts that an expired token is accepted; the bad test and the bad code agree, and both ordinary CI and red-green are green
